known.via: English Wikipedia "Merritt Island AVA" (redirects to "Merritt Island (California)")

climate: Summers are close to rainless. Vines draw on water stored in the soil, or on irrigation, but disease is rare.

blurb.text: A Clarksburg sub-area on an island in the Sacramento River Delta, in Yolo County, six miles south of Sacramento. It is about 6 miles long and 1.6 wide, with cool breezes and fog from San Francisco Bay and fertile loam soil.
